articles.title: Wall Street's BNY expands stablecoin services for institutions, starting with Circle's USDC
articles.snippet: The world's largest custody bank is adding USDC custody and minting services as stablecoins move deeper into traditional finance.

articles.title: BIS warns stablecoins are more like ETFs than actual money, and they're creating FX risk
articles.snippet: BIS's latest annual report dives into stablecoins and AI trends.

articles.title: Breez launches Bitcoin-to-stablecoin payments across more than 30 blockchains
articles.snippet: The new SDK feature lets developers route payments from Bitcoin balances to recipients in USDC and USDT without requiring users to hold stablecoins.

articles.title: BIS warns stablecoins risk fragmenting global financial system
articles.snippet: The Basel-based institution said that private digital tokens fall short of the requirements for sound money and urged policymakers to accelerate work on tokenized forms of central bank and commercial bank money.

articles.title: The Stablecoin Founder Map Doesn't Match the Stablecoin Volume Map
articles.snippet: Emerging markets drive most real-world stablecoin usage, yet founder concentration and venture funding remain U.S.- and Europe-centric.
